rationale: Recalibrated from real workspace repos (usb-display, JARVIS, 3dprinter, LeShield, chronos-rag). Replaces speculative generic pillars with Serhat's actual proven engineering strengths: low-level C++/NVENC pipelines, cognitive agent architectures, distributed multi-MCU hardware, and zero-knowledge privacy infrastructure.

USB 2.0 loopback transport over ADB reverse
